messages:
rita: FYIMorning we have a credentials provisioning failure hitting SSO-enabled tenants. Standup flagged ~12 affected signups, incl. 4 in trial and 2 on renewal path. Need comms + prioritization.
dan: Root cause preliminary: our cert issuance flow to the customer's IdP is timing out due to an upstream CA rate limit. Ops is throttling retries; opened ticket INC-4622.
omar: I've scoped a short-term mitigation: bypass non-critical cert rotation for onboarding path and do a manual cert mint for priority tenants. ETA for first manual pushes: ~30m.
priya: I'll draft the outreach templates. Recommend two variants: (1) high-touch + phone outreach for renewal-risk accounts, (2) short email for trial/light-touch. Keep tone apologetic, clear on steps, and include escalation contact.
lena: I'll compile the affected list with renewal windows and ARR tags. Prioritize any accounts with <60 days to renewal and mark them "renewal-risk".
cs-bot: Incident logged: sso-provisioning-failures at 2026-03-21T13:04Z. Severity: medium. RCA due 48h.
rita: Good. Priya paste draft here and tag me for sign-off.
priya: Draft - high-touch (call + email):

---
Hi {{customer_name}} team,

We're contacting you about a temporary delay in provisioning SSO for new tenants. During onboarding, our certificate provisioning to third-party identity providers is experiencing errors for a small subset of customers, which can delay SSO activation.

What we're doing: the engineering team is applying a targeted workaround to generate certificates manually for impacted tenants and coordinating with the CA provider to lift rate limits. We expect prioritized tenants to be enabled within the next hour; we will update you as each tenant is activated.

If you rely on SSO to complete onboarding or have an upcoming renewal, reply here or escalate to lena@redwood.example for immediate assistance. We can schedule a 15-30 min enablement call to finish setup while we remediate.

We sincerely apologize for the interruption. We will follow up with a short incident summary and a full RCA within 48 hours.

Link: https://redwood.example/sso-incident-feedback
---

priya: Draft - generic (email):

---
Hi,

Some customers may see a short delay in SSO activation as we address a provisioning error with our certificate issuer. Core product functionality remains available for provisioned tenants. If your onboarding is blocked, reply with the tenant id and we will prioritize.

We will send an incident summary and offer a free enablement session or a $150 account credit for affected customers.
---

priya: Any edits? Keep the phone outreach for accounts marked by lena as "renewal-risk".
rita: Change "expect prioritized tenants to be enabled within the next hour" to "we aim to enable prioritized tenants as quickly as possible and will update you within the hour" to avoid strict ETA.
omar: Confirmed manual cert pushes are ready. I'll do a dry run on two non-prod tenants now.
lena: Sharing the affected list in the CRM and tagging renewal owners. Three accounts flagged high-risk: AcmeCo, Braxton, and Meridian - all renewal meetings scheduled in next 45d.
dan: Ops: please snapshot the CA error codes and attach to INC-4622. We need the logs for postmortem and to support any vendor escalation.
priya: Updated drafts with wording tweak. I'll prepare the email + a separate phone script for AMs. Pasting final phone script snippet: "Hi, it's Priya from Redwood. We're proactively calling because SSO activation for your tenant is delayed due to a certificate issuance issue. We're ready to manually enable SSO for you now and can walk through any required verification; should take under 15 minutes."
lena: AMs will call AcmeCo and Braxton after we send the email; Meridian prefers email-first. I'll add the suggested credit/enablement offer to the account notes.
rita: Send batch #1 (3 high-touch) in 20m after omar confirms 2 manual certs succeed in prod. Priya, include the survey link and 2 micro-questions about onboarding friction in the follow-up. Also log any promo/credit approvals.
cs-bot: Reminder: RCA draft upload requested to /incidents/sso-provisioning-failures by 2026-03-23T13:04Z.
omar: Dry run successful. Scheduling manual cert pushes now. Will post when done.
priya: I'll queue emails to low-touch customers at 13:40Z and hold high-touch until manual certs confirm.

rita: Thanks all. Label any inbound customer replies with "priority-sso". Keep this thread updated with manual enablement timestamps per tenant. Close when all affected tenants show SSO active. :phone: :white_check_mark:
